description: This file defines an interface for a Radix Tree data structure in C, including function declarations for creation, deletion, insertion, removal, lookup, and iteration over the tree.

methods.name: li_radixtree_new
methods.description: Creates a new instance of a radix tree.

methods.name: li_radixtree_free
methods.description: Frees the radix tree and associated resources, using a user-provided function to free stored data.

methods.name: li_radixtree_insert
methods.description: Inserts a key-value pair into the radix tree; returns previous data if key was overwritten.

methods.name: li_radixtree_remove
methods.description: Removes a key from the radix tree; returns data from the removed node.

methods.name: li_radixtree_lookup
methods.description: Looks up the longest matching prefix for a given key in the radix tree.

methods.name: li_radixtree_lookup_exact
methods.description: Looks up an exact key match in the radix tree.

methods.name: li_radixtree_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over each node in the radix tree, applying a callback function.
